ValidationRule.description: IM-381:You cannot perform any action or edits on a completed Initiative
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.IM_Initiative_Validation__c && AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed')) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c),'Completed') && NOT(ISCHANGED(Name)) && NOT(ISCHANGED(CityView_Display_Name__c)) && NOT(ISCHANGED(CityView_Description__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: No Actions should be performed on Completed Initiatives.
